enabled.description: Whether the dependency is enabled. The values of disabled dependencies are not merged into the chart. Supports Helm `tpl`.

additionalProperties.description: A dependency, keyed by name: a set of chart values with an `enabled` key, merged into the values of the chart when enabled.

description: Dependencies of the chart: sets of chart values that are merged into the values of the chart when the dependency is enabled. Each dependency contains a complete chart values structure. See [dependencies](/truecharts-common/dependencies).
